description: ARM storage account without infrastructure encryption or blob soft delete
note: CIS Azure 4.2. AZU-0061 responds correctly to requireInfrastructureEncryption -- setting it clears the finding, which is what makes this case worth having. AZU-0056 was labelled here until 2026-09-23 and was then removed, because the scanner no longer reports it on an ARM target at all: the adapter cannot satisfy it, so it separates nothing (ARM_UNSATISFIABLE_TRIVY_RULES, and corpus/README.md for the measurement). The case still earns its place on AZU-0061 alone -- it is the one create-time storage property the ARM adapter does read.
